# OCTAGON — Operator Assistant Architecture

> A local-first cognitive workspace for competition demonstration: planning, retrieval, governance, and operational workflow execution with full sovereignty.

## Main sections

- [OCTAGON Operator Console](/) — Root portal; select SYSTEM or PATHFINDER entry point
- [SYS_STATUS Dashboard](/dashboard) — Live system metrics, routing distribution chart, and recent activity feed
- [MEMORY_BANK](/memory) — Browse, search, tag-filter, create, and edit markdown-style memory entries
- [DOCTRINE](/doctrine) — Governance rules with priority ordering, scope (local/cloud/hybrid), conditions, and active toggle
- [WORKFLOWS](/workflows) — Operational workflow tracking with per-step execution mode and status
- [ROUTING](/routing) — Interactive routing evaluator: local vs cloud scoring and decision history
- [SCENARIOS](/scenarios) — Competition demo scenarios with step-by-step status management

## Sub-applications

- [Pathfinder Governance](/pathfinder/) — Cognitive observation engine: multi-domain field analysis, RAPIDS protocol, sovereign dispatch
- [SPECTRA-7](/spectra7/) — Anomaly investigation and spectral analysis surface
